regions.merged_text: God bless you His lamb with Philip and all the rest. I am glad you are well. You always seem well out there. I have been here since last April. Thanks be to God it is quite an ideal place - 18 novices. The youngest about 17 ... to 23. Hope philip keeps well. Our Fr. Julius is down there some where in Tucson. He expects to go in Jan- uary to the Guam Missions. There has been some talk of our getting a place in Tucson.

regions.merged_text: God bless you Miss Lamb - you and yours. Glad to hear from you - and about Philip. I hope that operation - and preparation therefor, may be not too serious. At all events try and avoid anxiety - and trust in our Dear Lord for Every thing.
